text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Zimbabwe's flue-cured tobacco crop yield is now estimated at 205 million kg, marginally above last year's record 202 million kg and worth Z$6 billion to producers.
- A man has been jailed for two-and-a-half years for robbing a Japanese tourist of Z$20,000.

- President Robert Mugabe is expected to leave Harare on Tuesday for an Organisation of African Unity extraordinary session scheduled for Lome, Togo to discuss the crisis in the Great Lakes region, with emphasis on eastern Zaire.
